name: Wuxi Longsheng Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Wuxi Longsheng Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, sales, and service of automotive parts products in China and internationally. The company operates through the Engine Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) System Business, New Energy Business, and Precision Components Business segments.
